    • FAQs

      Questions you may have, answered with
      • What are the key features of the Apple iPad 9?
        The Apple iPad 9 features a 10.2-inch Retina display, A13 Bionic chip, and supports the first-generation Apple Pencil. It comes with 64GB or 256GB storage options and is available in Wi-Fi only or Wi-Fi + Cellular models. The device runs on iPadOS and offers up to 10 hours of battery life.
        How'd we do?
      • How does the iPad 9's display compare to other models?
        The iPad 9's 10.2-inch Retina display offers a resolution of 2160 x 1620 pixels. It's not as advanced as the Liquid Retina or Mini-LED displays found in higher-end models like the iPad Air and iPad Pro, which provide better color accuracy and brightness.
        How'd we do?
      • What are the connectivity options for the iPad 9?
        The iPad 9 is available in two connectivity options: Wi-Fi only and Wi-Fi + Cellular. The Wi-Fi + Cellular model supports 4G LTE networks, allowing for internet access without Wi-Fi, which is beneficial for users needing connectivity on the go.
        How'd we do?
